content: अप्रधान {%a.%} Subordinate, secondary, inferior; आवां तावदप्रधानौ <ls>H. 2</ls>. .{@-नम्@} (˚ता, ˚त्वम्) .²1 Subordinate or secondary state, inferiority. .²2 A secondary or subordinate act. (The word अप्रधान usually occurs in the neuter gender either by itself, or as an attribute to a noun, or as last member of <ab>comp.</ab>)
